name: noddle-draw
description: Read, create and edit open-source noddle draw diagram boards, browse versions and comment.
long_description: MCP server for noddle draw (draw.noddle.dev) — the open-source, no-sign-up whiteboard. Agents can list and read boards, create and update diagrams (nodes, edges, pages), browse versions and post comments. Point NODDLE_BASE_URL at your own instance when self-hosting. Python standard library only — no install step.

base_url.title: noddle draw URL
base_url.description: Origin of the noddle draw instance (your own when self-hosting).

agent_name.title: Agent name
agent_name.description: Display name on the agent's comments and version snapshots.

ai_provider.title: AI provider (optional)
ai_provider.description: Bring-your-own-key provider for generate_diagram: claude, openai, gemini, openrouter or custom. Leave empty to use the instance's free pool.

ai_key.title: AI provider key (optional)
ai_key.description: Sent only to the noddle draw instance per call; never stored.
